title: US markets: the daily wrap
dek: How the S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq opened and closed each trading day, the gap at the open, and the reasons reporters gave. Dates are US dates; the close comes at 2:30 am IST.
seoTitle: S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq today: open, close and gap, day by day

glance.what: The S&P 500 fell 0.23% to 7,323.63 on 18 November, its fifth loss in a row. The Dow fell 1.11% as health insurers slid, while the Nasdaq rose 0.42%.
glance.why: Wall Street's swings have been driven by Nvidia's leadership crisis, hotter inflation data that raised bets on a Fed rate rise, and oil prices. Big US moves often set the tone for Indian markets the next morning.
glance.next: Anthropic's shares, reportedly priced at $83, are expected to start trading on 19 November.

forYou: Indian IT companies earn much of their money in the US, and foreign investors move money between the two markets, so a sharp Wall Street fall often shows up in Indian shares the next morning. This is information, not investment advice.

upcoming.label: 19 Nov
upcoming.text: Anthropic expected to start trading on Nasdaq

next: Anthropic's first day of trading on 19 November, and whether the S&P 500's losing run continues.

events.title: Gap up and the S&P 500's best day since April
events.summary: The S&P 500 opened higher and rallied 2.35%, its best day since 8 April, as oil prices fell, CNBC reports via StockTitan. All 11 sectors rose. Nvidia fell about 4% after its board opened an investigation into reports about CEO Jensen Huang.
events.status: Market data · TheStreet, Zacks via Yahoo Finance

events.title: Gap down on hotter inflation; Nvidia falls 5%
events.summary: Stocks opened lower and closed down after October's core inflation rose 0.3%, more than forecast, CNBC reports, adding that expectations of a Federal Reserve rate rise next month grew. Technology was the weakest sector, and Nvidia ended down about 5%.

events.title: Gap up as CoreWeave's results revive the AI trade
events.summary: The S&P 500 opened higher and closed up 1.31% after cloud company CoreWeave beat forecasts and raised its outlook, which lifted chip and AI shares, CNBC reports. Every stock in the Philadelphia semiconductor index rose, per CappNotes. The S&P 500 ended within 2.6% of its record high, AP reports.

events.title: Gap down as Nvidia's CEO leaves and Iran tensions rise
events.summary: Wall Street opened lower and ended down 0.35% as Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO, rising tension with Iran and expectations of a Fed rate rise weighed on shares, Zacks reports via Yahoo Finance. Nineteen of the 30 Dow stocks fell.
events.status: Market data · Zacks via Yahoo Finance

events.title: Opens higher, then slips as chip stocks fall again
events.summary: Stocks opened higher but the S&P 500 closed down 0.40% as Nvidia and other chip shares fell after a hotter-than-expected inflation reading, Yahoo Finance reports. The Dow edged up 0.1%. All three indices still ended the week higher; the S&P 500 gained 2.5% for the week, AP reports.

events.title: Gap down and a 1.9% slide as chip stocks sell off before Nvidia's results
events.summary: The S&P 500 opened lower and fell 1.92%, its third straight loss, as chip and AI shares sold off, CNBC reports. Nvidia fell 4.1% a day before its earnings, after reports that its board is not considering bringing back Jensen Huang. Only consumer staples and utilities rose, per CappNotes.

events.title: Fourth straight loss for the S&P 500 as software and health shares fall
events.summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.03% to 7,340.53 and the Nasdaq had its fourth loss in a row, per Reuters and CappNotes. All 11 sectors fell. Software companies such as Salesforce and Intuit, and health insurers, fell most; Reuters also points to worries about AI spending, hints from Fed officials that a rate rise is possible, and higher import prices. October retail sales rose more than forecast. Nvidia fell 0.44% before its results, then rose after hours. The opening level could not be confirmed from two reports, so this day has no gap figure.
events.differs: 24/7 Wall St reports bigger falls: Dow −1.85% (955 points) and Nasdaq −0.91%. Reuters and CappNotes agree on the figures above.

events.title: S&P 500 slips for a fifth day; Dow falls 1.1%, Nasdaq rises
events.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.23% to 7,323.63, its fifth loss in a row, per Yahoo Finance and StockTitan. The Dow fell 561 points while the Nasdaq rose 0.42%. Health insurers fell after a US government proposal to step up anti-fraud checks on Medicare Advantage plans. Minutes of the Fed's last meeting showed nearly all officials expect further rate rises may be needed, per the Motley Fool. Nvidia fell 2.9% the day after its results. Amazon, an Anthropic investor, rose before Anthropic's share sale. The opening level could not be confirmed from two reports, so this day has no gap figure.
events.status: Market data · Yahoo Finance, Motley Fool
events.differs: Health insurer falls differ: the Motley Fool reports UnitedHealth −10.2% and Humana −13%; Yahoo Finance reported about 6% each during the day.
